_comment: SANITISED, Core-owned federation observability SNAPSHOT for the FOM (Federation Operations Map). Aggregate + BANDED counts only — NO PII, NO identities, NO CPIF values, NO internal IDs, NO permissions/authority. Point-in-time (see generatedAt), NOT live: the map OBSERVES the federation and is NEVER a source of truth. Generated by a read-only governance-time sweep (governance/drift-sweep-runbook-v1.md), then sanitised + banded. People-count bands (R0 EO 2026-06-18): 0 / Active (1-4) / 5-9 / 10-19 / 20+ — never an exact count <5 at a named entity. Integrity counts are STRUCTURAL (exact), not people. A value that could not be verified is null, never a guess.
note: v12 (2026-11-25, bus 161, R0 «go» 25.11): regenerated by the read-only drift sweep against registry v12 — RusJAz (psql), community.group + MoyPolk (Supabase), taxonomy API (public). Changes from the 2026-06-18 snapshot: RUSJAZ-FDN removed (retired into the one CEA CIC, registry v9); ZNANIYE, BALTICA and RU-ONLINE-EUREKA parented to CEA; ZNANIYE-STRATFORD and ZNANIYE-FINCHLEY added; MoyPolk shown as retired (brand retired into Community Group 2026-11-03), geography served by community.group; identity no longer means Keycloak (R0 act 2026-11-14). Member bands = distinct ACTIVE team members on the RusJAz nodes anchored to the code (CEA is anchored on both RusJAz and community.group; its band counts the RusJAz CEA CIC node only). Institution region = the node's ITL1 code, else the one region all its campuses share. Was: generatedAt 2026-06-18, geography steward MoyPolk, RUSJAZ-FDN as FOUNDATION parent of ZNANIYE and BALTICA, strayNodes 1, subjectsOnNonCanonicalNodes Active, community-group cpifLinked Active.

contracts.note: ACTIVE operational read-projection contract (R0 EO 2026-06-18); not a layer; Core stores no membership data; federation-facing membership conforms to it.

integrity.note: Structural integrity counts are exact. orphanOrg/orphanCampus/orphanRegion/campus-institution mismatch = 0 on RusJAz; orphanOrg and regions missing ITL1 = 0 on community.group; regions missing ITL1 = 0 on MoyPolk; no node or organisation still carries RUSJAZ-FDN. strayNodes = nodes with an empty slug: the PENDING demo node (baseline) plus, new since 2026-06-18, the active ZNANIYE institution node — logged for investigation, not an incident class (runbook Step 4). subjectsOnNonCanonicalNodes = federated subjects attached to nodes with no canonical anchor — banded; grown from Active, logged for investigation.
